finding.title: Five custom actions previously claimed success without their required server receipt
finding.cause: The actions used only RPC error and ignored data. Existing SQL already supplies a success/request/count receipt.
finding.repair: Validate confirmed outcomes and matching request or target identity before revalidation or success feedback; reject null, negative, contradictory, wrong-request and impossible-count results. Matching staging replay without added remains accepted per the existing SQL contract.
